  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰색의 분말 · 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장 제조

  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요

활성엽산 액티폴릭 800+Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate

Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 200mg of Vitamin C, 8.5mg of Zinc, 800μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 200mg Vitamin C, 8.5mg Zinc, 800μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 1800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (200mg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (800μg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 고온다습, 직사광선을 피하여 건조하고 서늘한 곳에서 보관 및 유통하십시오. 영·유아 및 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 10μg of Vitamin B12, 3mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 12.5mg of Zinc, 800μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 10μg Vitamin B12, 3mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 12.5mg Zinc, 800μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B12 labelled (10μg / 270mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (3mg / 270mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (50mg / 270mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (12.5mg / 270mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (800μg / 270mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흐린 보라색의 원형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 고온다습, 직사광선을 받지 아니하는 건조하고 서늘한 곳에서 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
